The Docker image runs this command by default. Its settings are in [Configuration](/configuration).

```text
Run pending migrations, then serve the API

Usage: tachyon serve [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>  Config file. Without it, tachyon.toml is read if it exists. Every setting can also come from a TACHYON_* environment variable
  -h, --help             Print help
```
